strings.subtitle: — Mũnyamũri wa faili —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kũhũthĩra na kũrekereria gũtirĩ. Hũthĩra kĩbato kĩrĩ thĩ.
strings.shred_button: N Y A M Ũ R A
strings.ssd_warning:
Kĩrathimo! Kũrĩ SSD, njĩra ya kwandĩka igũrũ ndĩrĩ kĩhooto kĩa kũnyamũra nĩ ũndũ wa TRIM.
Mũbango ũyũ nĩ wa HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faili "{name}" nĩĩkũandĩkwo igũrũ na nĩĩkũnyamũrwo.

Ũkĩrĩte?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Ĩno nĩ kĩrũgĩ (.lnk). Kĩrũgĩ kĩene kĩgathambagwo.

Faaĩli ĩrĩa ĩrĩ kuuma nĩĩkĩgũtigwo ta mĩhaka.

Na mbere?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Ĩno nĩ diski ya mũtandao (\\server\share).
Kwandĩka hethĩro ndĩgũtũma mũhaka wa gũthambia — server nĩĩngĩhota gũkorwo na mabuthi, deduplication kana CoW.

Na mbere?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Ĩno nĩ diski ĩhota gũeherio (USB / HDD ya nja).
Mũtwarithania nĩĩngĩhota gũtiga mabuthi ma tene.

Na mbere?
strings.report_title: ✅  FAILI NĨ YAANDĨKIRWO IGŨRŨ NA NĨ YANYAMŨRIRWO
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS mĩrĩngo ya ũhoro ĩngĩ (ADS) ndĩrĩ kũrũmĩrĩrwo.
• Ibuku rĩa USN ndĩrĩ kũthambirwo.
• Ithandũkũ cia kĩĩni na kũhũthĩra kwa matu
  (OneDrive na ingĩ) ndĩrĩ kũhũthĩrwo.
strings.step_delete: Gũthambiria na kũhĩtũka nyũngũ ya thĩ
strings.status_full: Ihinda rĩothe rĩaandĩkirwo igũrũ na uthiru. Kũruta ndĩngĩhota — indo itona uthiru o rĩmwe.
strings.status_fast: Kĩongo, mũthia na mĩrĩngo 4 MB nĩ yaandĩkirwo igũrũ. Gĩcunjĩ gĩothe gĩtirĩ kũhũthĩrwo, ĩndĩ nĩ ũndũ wa itina, kũruta gĩcunjĩ gĩothe na indo cia arĩa angĩ ndĩngĩhota. Kũrĩ rĩandĩko rĩa hitho, hũthĩra mũbango MWIYU.
strings.status_empty: Faili yarĩ ndĩ na kĩndũ, kwandĩka igũrũ kwatirĩ gũkena. Nĩ yanyamũrirwo.
strings.error_permission: Ndĩngĩhota kũhota faaĩli. Nĩĩngĩkorwo ĩhumbĩte harĩ programu ĩngĩ. Humba na ũgerie rĩngĩ.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ĩno nĩ mũtũngũ wa kĩũria. Mĩtũngũ ndĩhota gũthambagwo — faaĩli ĩrĩa ĩrĩ kuuma nĩĩkĩgũtigwo ta mĩhaka.
strings.error_reparse: Ĩno nĩ faaĩli ya gũtuĩra handũ (OneDrive kana ĩngĩ). Ũhoro wayo nĩ kũrĩ cloud, ti diski — gũtirĩ kĩndũ kĩa gũthambia haha.
strings.error_not_file: Ĩno ti faaĩli (folda kana kĩndũ kĩngĩ). Hũra faaĩli.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faaĩli ĩno ĩrĩ na mĩtũngũ ĩngĩ ya ũkĩrĩ ({n} mothe). Mĩtũngũ ya ũkĩrĩ ndĩrĩ mwena wa mbere — marĩĩna mothe nĩ mĩhaka. Ũngĩthambia na njĩra ya rĩu, ũhoro ũgakĩrĩo na ũgakũnĩo nginya 32 bytes, no kĩrĩa gĩtigaire gĩgakorwo gĩhota kũhũrwo na mĩtũngũ ĩngĩ. Thambia mĩtũngũ yothe mbere.
strings.error_compressed:
Faaĩli nĩ ĩkũnĩtio, ĩhumbĩtio kana nĩ ndogo. Kwandĩka na ziro ndĩgũtũma mũhaka wa gũthambia ũhoro wa tene nĩgũkorwo NTFS ĩmĩigaga na njĩra ĩngĩ.

Eheria kĩmenyithia: hũra iboko ya ũmotho → Mĩhaka → Mbere → eheria 'Kũnĩa' na/kana 'Kũhumba'. Hĩndĩ ĩyo, ambĩrĩria SHREDDER rĩngĩ.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Mafaaĩli {count} magathambagwo.
Ũnene wothe: {size}.

Thikĩrĩria mũrũrĩ mbere ya gũthiĩ na mbere.
Wĩra ũyũ ndwĩhota gũthũkũrũo.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Eheria mafaaĩli {count} mothe kuuma mũrũrĩ-inĩ?

Mafaaĩli mwene NDI AGATHAMBAGWO — mũrũrĩ wĩgiĩ.
strings.hardlink_text:
Faaĩli "{name}" ĩrĩ na mĩtũngũ ĩngĩ ya ũkĩrĩ ({nlink} mothe).

Ũhoro ũgathambagwo nĩ ũndũ wa marĩĩna mothe.
No mabuthi (32 bytes) magatigwo rungu rwa marĩĩna mangĩ harĩ folda.

No ũkenũkaga gũthambia mabuthi aya na guoko.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Hũra kũrĩ mĩtũngũ yothe ya ũkĩrĩ mũrũrĩ-inĩ
